name: Velvet
description: A private library for your personal 18+ video collection. Pick folders on the NAS and get single-eye thumbnails for VR/180° side-by-side files, a frame strip to see what a scene contains, freeform tags with ratings, duplicate detection for re-downloads, and playback with a Left/Right/SBS eye switch. Files are indexed in place — nothing is copied and no content leaves the device.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.1: playback fixes — the player trusts the core's playback_mode, so multi-audio MP4s play directly instead of asking for an HLS session the core rejects; HLS sessions resume at the saved position with the correct absolute time; thumbnails retry while the service restarts and show a placeholder instead of a broken image. 1.0.0: first release — a private library for your own 18+ collection. Add folders with the EthOS picker, scan in place, and browse a thumbnail grid where VR side-by-side files show the left eye instead of a doubled frame. A detail view pairs six preview frames with ffprobe facts (per-eye dimensions, codec, bitrate, duration, size), freeform tags, a 1–5 rating and keep/reject marks. Duplicates are grouped by cleaned title and comparable runtime so re-downloads can be removed in bulk. Playback reuses the core Video Station pipeline (direct streaming or HLS for HEVC/MKV) with Left / Right / SBS eye switching, quality, audio tracks, speed and resume. Every account has its own index, tags and thumbnails; permanent deletion goes through the core file API behind a typed confirmation.
